name: lokerdollar-remote-job-market
title: Loker Dollar — Remote Jobs Paying USD (weekly sample)
description: Free weekly sample of active remote jobs paying in USD, parsed into structured columns: required skills, normalised salary, remote type, and geo-fit / Indonesia-fit signals. Per-column fill rates are published in the README. Full daily dataset: https://lokerdollar.com/en/data

resources.name: sample-remote-jobs
resources.description: 50 active, salary-disclosing remote roles, refreshed weekly. Drawn from a live corpus of 5,099 active roles.

fields.name: pay_min
fields.description: Lower bound of the stated range

fields.name: pay_max
fields.description: Upper bound of the stated range

fields.name: skills_required
fields.description: JSON array — must-have skills, extracted from the posting

fields.name: skills_bonus
fields.description: JSON array — nice-to-have skills. Not yet populated; see the Filled column.

fields.name: green_flags
fields.description: JSON array — positive signals (async, equity, visa support). Not yet populated; see the Filled column.

fields.name: red_flags
fields.description: JSON array — caution signals (unpaid trial, vague scope). Sparse; see the Filled column.

fields.name: indonesian_context
fields.description: JSON — Indonesia-fit notes (timezone overlap, hiring posture)
